Albion Online item artwork: copyright Sandbox Interactive GmbH.
Bundled for item identification in the Albion Craft Lab calculator.

10,488 original 128x128 normal-quality item images:
https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/<ITEM_ID>.png?quality=1&size=128
Official endpoint announcement:
https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/131017-Update-on-API-New-Endpoints/

Sources downloaded October 2026. Pixel-identical art is deduplicated.
158 lossless WebP atlases, 10,490 item IDs, 10,074 unique images.
127 source IDs without available artwork use local category SVG placeholders.
Quality 2-5 is represented by a local numbered badge.
The application does not download item art at runtime.
